statement: We have shown that LDQ(Dstd )-Consensus is a sound proof system for true QBFs, by giving a linear-time strategy extraction algorithm. Prior to this work, no polynomial-time strategy extraction was known even for the weaker system Q(Dstd )-Consensus (soundness there was established only indirectly, via preservation of countermodels [16]). Our result has a direct practical implication for solvers such as DepQBF [14]: long-distance resolution can now be combined with the standard dependency scheme and a winning strategy for the existential player can be extracted efficiently from the resulting proof when the QBF is true. Whether LDQ(Drrs )-Consensus is sound remains open. As shown in Section 3.2, our strategy extraction already fails for Q(Drrs )-Consensus, so settling this will require a different technique.
